decisions.reason: The plug-in line has its own page and extends the core data integration business at low marginal cost, so its results likely meet aspirations and nothing prompts problemistic search.
The building digital twin service is still only mentioned and its results are uncertain, but industry growth and the firm's slack allow it to keep exploring this emerging market.

The authentication delegation service overlaps with the Identity Service and may eventually be folded into it, but its carrying costs near the core offer are low, so withdrawal within a year is unlikely.
The open GIS development framework embodies the firm's strategy of open, extensible components and supports its project business, so it remains strategically central.
The Identity Service was actively promoted for seamless integration and fits the firm's move toward integration with enterprise systems, so management keeps it.
The newly launched consulting workshop has its own page, builds on existing expertise at minimal cost and feeds project business, so it is too early and too cheap to drop.
